OBTAINIUM

Updates,
straight from GitHub.

Obtainium checks 21Life releases and lets you know when a new version is available.

Get Obtainium ↗

  1. Install Obtainium

    Download it from its official website.

  2. Add 21Life

    In “Add App”, paste this address.

    https://github.com/marco201091-glitch/21life

  3. Confirm the release

    Check the detected app and continue with installation.

Use official channels and verify published checksums. Keep the same channel for updates: GitHub and F-Droid versions may use different signatures and services.
